components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #185c39; color: #fff; border: 1px solid #185c39; border-radius: 6px; padding: 0.55rem 0.9rem; font: inherit; font-weight: 650; min-height: 2.75rem; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #102f1f; border-color: #102f1f; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #185c39; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { cursor: wait; opacity: 0.65; }

components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #fffef9; color: #185c39; border: 1px solid #185c39; border-radius: 6px; padding: 0.55rem 0.9rem; font: inherit; font-weight: 650; min-height: 2.75rem; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #e8f0e9; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #185c39; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ledger Rows

motion.name: logbook-stamp
motion.purpose: Single authored moment. Risk and status marks settle once on appear.

dos: Do pair every risk fill with its plain text label and keep the label readable on the wash.
Do keep body and secondary text at 4.5 to 1 or better, tinting secondary text from the field hue.
Do theme selection, caret, focus, scrollbars, underline offset, and numerals from the palette.
Do give headings more air above than below and let them wrap in balance.
Do honor reduced motion by disabling the stamp settle entirely.
donts: Don't put a kicker or eyebrow above a heading.
Don't mark cards, alerts, or list items with a thick colored side border.
Don't pair a border with a shadow on the same card.
Don't use gradient text, glass blur, hard offset shadows, sparklines, or emoji icons.
Don't use monospace to look technical. Reserve it for code and measurement only.
Don't ship a raster, photo, or illustration without provenance in the shipping file.
keyCharacteristics: Paper ground with paper cards, flat and border-drawn
Ledger rows for facts, figures, and plan lists
Stamped risk marks with plain Low, Moderate, and High labels
System typeface with tabular numerals for all data
One settle motion, disabled under reduced motion
narrative.overview: TANIM looks like a paper logbook kept at the farm gate, not a software dashboard. Pages sit on a pale green paper ground. Content lives on lighter paper cards with plain 1px borders. Numbers read as ruled ledger rows. Risk reads as a stamped mark with a plain label, never as a glowing badge. The mood is calm public service. Headings speak alone, with no kicker above them. Color is quiet except for the three risk inks, which always arrive with text labels. The one motion in the system is the stamp settling when a risk or status mark appears.

rules.body: A color fill never carries meaning alone. Every risk fill, map region, and legend mark ships with its text label next to it.
rules.name: The Plain Label Rule

rules.body: Field Green is the single voice. Risk inks appear only on risk marks, map regions, and their legend.
rules.name: The Quiet Page Rule

rules.body: No kicker or eyebrow sits above a heading. If a line adds nothing the heading does not say, delete the line.
rules.name: The Heading Speaks Rule

rules.body: Ratios, areas, counts, and step counts always use tabular numerals so digits align down a ledger column.
rules.name: The Data Lines Up Rule

rules.body: A surface declares elevation once, with a border. No card pairs a 1px border with a soft shadow.
rules.name: The One Edge Rule
